## About
We are a fully licensed auto repair shop in Pomona, California. We handle repairs, replacements and service, from engine work to smog and emissions checks, and we try to keep the whole thing no-hassle for you.
For tires, head to Star Tire & Auto Center, our tire shop, where the crew handles a wide range of tire services. Keeping you safe on the road comes first.
Pomona drivers have given us a 4.4 rating from 166 Google reviews, and customers mention James and Fernando by name.

## Services
- Smog and emissions checks: We are a STAR-certified station for smog and emissions checks.
- Engine repair: Engine repair alongside our emissions testing services.
- Tire services: A wide range of tire services at Star Tire & Auto Center, our tire shop. Call them at (909) 622-4633.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us at 909-622-4542 or use the estimate request form to get a free estimate.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We are on E Holt Ave in Pomona, and we also have a location at 1205 E Holt Avenue.

Q: Are you open on the weekend?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.
